literal: Desired things, as desired, because of attaining, doing penance here will be attempted.
translation: Because penance achieves whatever is desired exactly as desired, it is undertaken here in this world.
modern: விரும்பியவற்றை விரும்பியபடியே அடைய முடிவதால், தவம் இந்த உலகத்திலேயே பலரால் முயன்று செய்யப்படும்.
explanation: This couplet explains why people undertake the difficult practice of penance. It states that penance has the power to grant whatever one desires, exactly in the way it is desired. Because of this ability to attain one's goals, the act of doing penance is actively attempted here in this world. The repetition of 'வேண்டிய' emphasizes the complete fulfillment of all wishes.
